---
title: "World Flags"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
# Send the list of flag filenames in w2560/ to Observable JS
ojs_define(flags = list.files("w2560", pattern = "\\.png$"))
```

```{ojs}
// Dropdown menu for the user to select a flag
viewof selected = Inputs.select(flags, {
  label: "Select a flag:",
  value: "us.png"
})

// Display the selected flag image from the w2560 folder
html`<img src="w2560/${selected}" alt="${selected}" style="max-width: 600px; border: 1px solid #ccc; margin-top: 1rem;">`
```
